title: Payoneer Alternatives 2026: Fees and Plans Compared
h1: Payoneer Alternatives 2026: Fees and Features Compared
metaDescription: Payoneer alternatives compared by published fees: Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury, Relay, Deel and Remote for cross-border payments and contractor management.
intro:
Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury and Relay replace Payoneer for receiving and holding funds, while Deel and Remote replace Payoneer for contractor management and payments. 

[Payoneer](https://www.payoneer.com) operates across 190 or more countries and territories and 70 or more currencies. It offers receiving accounts, payment requests, checkout, stablecoin settlement in Tether (USDT) and USD Coin (USDC), single, batch and mass payouts, Value-Added Tax (VAT) payments, Employer of Record (EOR), Contractor Management System (CMS), corporate cards and Working Capital Advance. Opening a standard account typically carries no monthly subscription fee, but Payoneer applies fees to incoming transactions, cross-currency receiving accounts, card processing, balance transfers and withdrawals.

Selecting an alternative depends on your payment path, such as receiving client funds, holding foreign currency reserves or managing global independent contractors. For broader comparisons of business financial tools, review our [business bank accounts roundup](/roundup/best-business-bank-accounts/), our [Wise alternatives guide](/alternatives/wise/) and our [Mercury alternatives breakdown](/alternatives/mercury/). Freelancers tracking client revenue can also examine our [accounting software for freelancers roundup](/roundup/best-accounting-software-for-freelancers/) and our [PayPal alternatives comparison](/alternatives/paypal/).

chooseSection.heading: How to Choose a Payoneer Alternative
chooseSection.body:
Selecting a Payoneer alternative depends on whether you primarily receive client funds, hold foreign balances, or pay a team of overseas independent contractors. Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury and Relay provide multi-currency accounts and domestic banking capabilities. Deel and Remote operate as contractor management and compliance platforms rather than digital wallets, handling contractor agreements, tax documentation and international wage disbursements.

Evaluate the cost of receiving client funds before picking an account. Payoneer charges 1% (with a $1.00 minimum) to receive funds through receiving accounts when the currency does not match your local currency. Payoneer also charges up to 3.99% plus $0.49 for payments funded by credit cards, and 1% for Automated Clearing House (ACH) debit payments in the United States (US). In contrast, Wise Business charges a one-time $31 fee to obtain local account details in 22 currencies, after which receiving non-wire domestic transfers in nine major currencies is free. Airwallex provides free account collection across 20 or more currencies on its $0 Explore plan, charging 2.80% plus $0.30 for domestic card processing and 4.30% plus $0.30 for international cards.

Compare conversion markups and withdrawal rules for withdrawing earnings to a local bank. Payoneer charges a fixed $1.50 fee for domestic local-currency withdrawals in supported corridors such as USA to USA in USD. When currency conversion takes place, Payoneer charges between 1.2% and 4%, with minimum withdrawal fees up to $20.00 applying in selected countries. Wise Business uses the mid-market exchange rate without an added margin, charging conversion fees starting from 0.23%. Airwallex charges a 0.5% margin above interbank rates for major currencies and 1% for other currencies. Mercury charges $0 for outgoing USD international wires, while applying a 1% currency exchange fee on non-USD wires.

Review ongoing maintenance and account inactivity penalties. Payoneer charges an annual account fee of $29.95 if your account receives less than $6,000.00 in payments over any 12 consecutive months. Payoneer also charges an annual card fee of $29.95 for physical cards. Airwallex Explore, Mercury and Relay Starter charge $0 in monthly account maintenance fees regardless of transaction volume.

Five checks to complete before choosing a provider:

- How do your clients pay, such as local bank transfers, credit cards, or marketplace disbursements?
- What currency will you receive, and does the account support local receiving details in that denomination?
- What percentage markup applies when converting balances to your home currency?
- Are you managing contractor contracts and tax forms, or do you only need to send payments?
- Does the provider charge an ongoing annual fee if your payment volume drops below a set threshold?

alternatives.heading: Wise Business Pricing and Currency Conversion
alternatives.body:
Wise Business provides multi-currency business accounts allowing companies to receive, hold, convert and send international funds. Registration is free, and the platform charges a one-time setup fee of $31 to unlock local receiving account details in 22 currencies. Wise Business operates on a pay-as-you-go pricing schedule. Funds can be held across multiple currency balances for free. Domestic payments received through non-wire methods in Australian dollars, Canadian dollars, euros, British pounds, Hungarian forints, New Zealand dollars, Philippine pesos, Singapore dollars and US dollars are free.

Receiving a USD wire or Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) payment costs a flat fee of $6.11 per transaction. Receiving a SWIFT transfer in British pounds costs 2.16 GBP, and receiving a SWIFT transfer in euros costs 2.39 EUR. Sending money and converting currency starts at 0.23% and varies by currency pair. Wise states that it uses the mid-market exchange rate without added markups, and provides volume discounts for accounts converting more than $25,000. Paying with the Wise Multi-Currency Card in a currency you already hold is free. Automated Teller Machine (ATM) withdrawals are free up to $250 per calendar month, after which Wise charges $1.95 plus 1.95% per withdrawal.

A worked cost comparison illustrates the differences between Payoneer and Wise Business. If a business receives a $5,000 USD domestic bank transfer from a client, Payoneer charges 1% ($50) for ACH debit, or $0 via a receiving account in your local currency. If the client pays via credit card, Payoneer charges up to 3.99% plus $0.49, totaling up to $199.99 ($199.50 plus $0.49). With Wise Business, receiving a $5,000 non-wire USD transfer is free. Receiving a $5,000 USD wire on Wise Business costs $6.11. 

Wise Business fits freelancers and businesses that receive recurring client payments in major currencies and want transparent conversion rates. Versus Payoneer, Wise Business does not provide working capital advances, built-in Value-Added Tax payments, checkout merchant processing, or integrated Employer of Record services.

alternatives.heading: Airwallex Multi-Currency Accounts and FX Margins
alternatives.body:
Airwallex provides global financial accounts for collecting, holding and transferring commercial funds. Its Explore plan costs $0 per user per month and includes business accounts supporting collection and holding in 20 or more currencies. Explore includes free batch transfers to 120 or more countries, interbank Foreign Exchange (FX) rates, multi-currency corporate cards with zero international transaction fees, expense management, bill pay, invoicing and up to 10 free Spend users. The Grow plan costs $12 per user per month plus a platform fee based on team size, adding approvals, purchase orders, budgets, Single Sign-On (SSO) and accounting synchronization with NetSuite and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Accelerate offers custom pricing for multi-entity enterprises.

Foreign exchange conversions on Airwallex cost 0.5% above interbank rates for major currencies, and 1% above interbank rates for all other currencies. Domestic transfers in USD and Canadian dollars are free. Local transfers reach 120 or more countries, while SWIFT transfers reach 200 or more countries at $15 to $25 per transaction. Accepting domestic payments with credit cards costs 2.80% plus $0.30, while international cards cost 4.30% plus $0.30. Local payment methods cost $0.30 plus underlying payment method fees. Airwallex also offers a Yield program paying up to 3.49% on USD on Explore, 3.64% on Grow, and 3.76% on Accelerate, subject to program terms.

A cost example clarifies the math. Converting $10,000 USD to a major foreign currency on Airwallex at 0.5% costs $50. On Payoneer, converting and withdrawing that same $10,000 carries a fee of 1.2% to 4%, costing between $120 and $400. Collecting a $5,000 payment from a domestic client via credit card on Airwallex costs 2.80% plus $0.30, which equals $140.30. On Payoneer, collecting $5,000 via credit card costs up to 3.99% plus $0.49, totaling up to $199.99, a difference of $59.69.

Airwallex fits international businesses that need multi-currency payment collection, published conversion fees and corporate employee cards. Versus Payoneer, Airwallex charges $15 to $25 per outgoing SWIFT transfer.

alternatives.heading: Mercury Business Banking and Wire Transfers
alternatives.body:
Mercury is a financial technology company that provides banking services through partner banks. Accounts carry up to $5,000,000 in FDIC insurance through sweep networks. The core Mercury account costs $0 per month with no minimum balance rules, no overdraft fees and free domestic wires, USD international wires, ACH transfers, checks and real-time payments. Mercury Plus costs $29.90 per month on annual billing, adding ACH debit invoicing at $1 per transaction, recurring billing and six months of free Xero accounting. Mercury Pro costs $299 per month on annual billing, eliminating ACH debit invoicing transaction fees.

International transfers sent in USD carry no fee from Mercury. Outgoing international wires sent in non-USD currencies incur a 1% currency exchange fee. Domestic wires cost $0. For accounts holding $250,000 or more, Mercury Treasury offers yields up to 4.31% through Mercury Advisory, LLC, an investment adviser registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Optional add-ons include Mercury Books at $35 per month and Mercury Payroll at $100 per month plus $50 per person paid, with both add-on charges waived through December 31, 2026.

A transaction scenario shows the cost difference. Sending three international wires totaling $10,000 in USD costs $0 in wire fees on Mercury. On Payoneer, sending funds from a balance to a recipient in another country costs up to 1% plus up to $4.00 per transfer, which on $10,000 could reach $100 plus transfer fees. If a company on Mercury sends a $10,000 wire in a foreign currency, Mercury's 1% FX fee equals $100. On Payoneer, foreign currency withdrawals and transfers carry markups of 1.2% to 4%, costing $120 to $400.

Mercury fits US-registered businesses and startups that need domestic banking and fee-free USD international wire transfers. Versus Payoneer, Mercury does not provide international local receiving accounts in foreign currencies.

alternatives.heading: Relay Checking Tiers and Cash Allocation
alternatives.body:
Relay is a financial technology company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Relay allows businesses to open multiple checking accounts to divide cash reserves. All plans include 50 credit cards, four debit cards, invoice generation and unlimited user permissions. International payment processing is provided by Community Federal Savings Bank and facilitated by Nium, Inc., with international wire fee amounts detailed in Relay's complete fee schedule.

Relay Starter costs $0 per month and includes 20 individual checking accounts, a 1.19% Annual Percentage Yield (APY) on savings and 1% cash back on credit cards. Relay Grow costs $30 per month ($360 per year) and includes a 14-day trial, offering 1.87% APY on savings, 1.25% credit card cash back, approval workflows and recurring invoices. Relay Scale lists a promotional price of $90 per month ($1,080 per year), marked down from its standard $120 monthly price ($1,440 per year). Scale provides 50 checking accounts, 3.21% APY on savings, 1.5% cash back and free same-day ACH transfers.

Evaluating account expenses over a full year highlights the cost structure. A business using Relay Starter pays $0 in annual platform fees, while opening up to 20 checking accounts to separate tax reserves, operating capital and payroll. Relay Grow costs $360 annually. By comparison, Payoneer charges no monthly software fee on standard accounts, but applies an annual account fee of $29.95 if the account receives under $6,000.00 across 12 consecutive months. Payoneer also charges $29.95 per year for its physical card.

Relay fits US small businesses that want multiple checking accounts to separate funds alongside cash back on card purchases. Versus Payoneer, Relay lists no multi-currency receiving accounts on its pricing page, and international wire fees sit in its full fee schedule.

alternatives.heading: Deel Contractor Management and Global Compliance
alternatives.body:
Deel is a global human resources and contractor management platform supporting businesses that hire, manage and pay international teams. Deel is not a business bank account or a multi-currency payment wallet; it is a workforce compliance and payroll management system. Deel Contractor plans start at $49 per contractor per month on a month-to-month agreement with no long-term contracts. The Contractor plan includes centralized contractor management, automated invoicing, document collection, worker classification compliance, tax form guidance and payment execution in 120 or more currencies.

For companies seeking worker classification protection, Deel Contractor of Record starts at $325 per contractor of record per month. For hiring direct international employees, Deel Employer of Record starts at $599 per employee per month across 130 or more countries. Deel also provides a US Professional Employer Organization (PEO) service starting at $125 per employee per month. Deel states that it serves over 40,000 customers across 150 or more countries.

A company managing five international independent contractors illustrates the pricing math. On Deel Contractor, five contractors cost $245 per month ($49 multiplied by five), totaling $2,940 per year. If the business utilizes Contractor of Record, five contractors cost $1,625 per month ($325 multiplied by five), or $19,500 annually. On Payoneer, managing contractor payments uses its Contractor Management System, with batch payouts supporting up to 1,000 payments per batch. Sending funds from a Payoneer balance to another Payoneer user in a different country costs up to 1% plus up to $4.00 per payment, which on five monthly $1,000 payments equals up to $50 plus $20, or $70 per month ($840 annually).

Deel fits growing businesses that hire independent contractors abroad and need strict legal compliance, contract templates and tax document collection. Versus Payoneer, Deel is a paid HR software platform that does not serve as a general-purpose wallet for receiving customer checkout payments.

alternatives.heading: Remote Contractor Onboarding and Indemnity Tiers
alternatives.body:
Remote is an international employment and contractor management platform that enables businesses to hire, onboard and pay workers worldwide. Remote Platform is included with no base fee, charging no setup or onboarding fees. Remote Contractor Management starts at $29 per active contractor per month. Companies only pay for contractors they actively pay during that billing cycle. The plan covers contractor onboarding in 190 or more countries, compliance screening, expenses, 1099-NEC form generation and disbursements in 70 or more currencies.

Remote Contractor Management Plus starts at $99 per contractor per month, providing up to $100,000 in indemnity per contractor (capped at $1,000,000 per company). Remote Contractor of Record starts at $325 per contractor of record per month. Remote Employer of Record starts at $599 per employee per month, Global Payroll costs $19 per employee per month, and US PEO starts at $99 per employee per month.

Comparing contractor management costs reveals the difference between Remote and Deel. Paying five active contractors per month on Remote Contractor Management costs $145 per month ($29 multiplied by five), which equals $1,740 per year. On Deel, those five contractors cost $245 per month, or $2,940 per year, making Remote $1,200 less expensive annually for baseline contractor management. On Contractor Management Plus, Remote costs $495 per month ($99 multiplied by five), or $5,940 per year, providing $100,000 in indemnity per worker.

Remote fits companies hiring international contractors that want an active-worker pricing model where dormant contractors incur no monthly charges. Versus Payoneer, Remote does not function as a checkout gateway and cannot be used to receive direct customer payments.

alternatives.heading: Who This Is Not For
alternatives.body:
This comparison evaluates published business payment fees and contractor management pricing. It does not suit every business situation.

- Sole proprietors seeking personal peer-to-peer transfers can start with our [PayPal alternatives guide](/alternatives/paypal/) instead of commercial multi-currency platforms.
- Businesses seeking physical branch cash deposits are better served by traditional banks rather than digital platforms, as detailed in our [business bank accounts roundup](/roundup/best-business-bank-accounts/).
- Companies that require direct, automated payout connections to freelance marketplaces like Upwork may prefer Payoneer, because Payoneer and Upwork have maintained an extended 15-year partnership.

alternatives.heading: What Would Change Our Answer
alternatives.body:
The analysis on this page reflects published fees and pricing checked on November 23, 2026. Several potential pricing changes would alter these recommendations:

- Payoneer lowering or removing its 1% non-local currency receiving account fee, or eliminating its $29.95 annual inactivity charge.
- Wise Business altering its $6.11 fixed USD wire receipt fee or introducing an ongoing monthly subscription.
- Airwallex adjusting its 0.5% major currency FX margin or increasing transfer charges on its Explore plan.
- Mercury introducing monthly maintenance fees on its core $0 account, or changing its 1% currency exchange fee on non-USD wires.
- Remote or Deel changing their baseline contractor management fees of $29 and $49 per worker per month.
- Relay updating its savings yields or removing the promotional $90 pricing on Relay Scale.

stillBetterFit.heading: When Payoneer Is Still the Better Fit
stillBetterFit.body:
Payoneer remains an effective option for international freelancers, e-commerce merchants and digital agencies operating across emerging markets and integrated platforms. Payoneer operates across 190 or more countries and territories and 70 or more currencies, offering receiving accounts in major global denominations. Payoneer and Upwork share an extended 15-year partnership, allowing freelance professionals to withdraw marketplace earnings directly to Payoneer balances.

Payoneer also provides features that standard commercial banks do not bundle. Payoneer supports stablecoin payments in USDT and USDC, Value-Added Tax payments, payment requests and payment links, merchant checkout processing, and Working Capital Advances for qualifying businesses. Payoneer also includes a Contractor Management System and batch payouts supporting up to 1,000 payments in a single file.

Opening a standard account typically carries no monthly fee, and balance-to-balance transfers between Payoneer accounts are free. If your business processes over $50,000 monthly, Payoneer offers custom pricing upon contacting sales. When your workflow depends on platform payout integrations across multiple countries and currencies, Payoneer provides cross-border infrastructure that domestic accounts do not match.

verdict: Wise Business and Airwallex publish low starting conversion fees and itemized receiving fees for international payments, Mercury and Relay deliver zero-fee domestic checking for United States entities, and Deel and Remote provide dedicated contractor compliance and onboarding. Payoneer remains suitable for marketplace sellers and freelancers relying on direct platform payout integrations across 190 or more countries. To choose the right Payoneer alternative, identify your top incoming payment methods, calculate your monthly foreign exchange volume, and compare the published transaction fees in the table above.

faqs.question: What is the best alternative to Payoneer?
faqs.answer: Wise Business and Airwallex are the closest alternatives for receiving, converting and holding multi-currency balances with published starting conversion fees from 0.23% (Wise Business) and 0.5% above interbank rates (Airwallex). Mercury and Relay fit US businesses needing domestic banking with wire capabilities, while Deel and Remote fit companies managing international contractor agreements and payroll.

faqs.question: Does Payoneer charge a monthly fee?
faqs.answer: Payoneer states that opening an account typically has no monthly subscription fee. However, Payoneer charges an annual account fee of $29.95 if your account receives less than $6,000.00 (or equivalent) in payments over any 12 consecutive months. Physical cards also carry an annual card fee of $29.95.

faqs.question: Is Wise cheaper than Payoneer?
faqs.answer: Wise Business charges a one-time $31 setup fee for receiving details in 22 currencies, and converts funds at mid-market exchange rates with fees starting from 0.23%. Payoneer charges 1% to receive funds in non-local currencies, up to 3.99% plus $0.49 for credit card receipts, and 1.2% to 4% for currency conversions and bank withdrawals. For converting foreign currencies, Wise Business generally has lower published markups.

faqs.question: What are Payoneer withdrawal fees?
faqs.answer: Withdrawing funds to a local bank account in the same country and currency (such as USA to USA in USD) costs a flat $1.50 fee. Withdrawing to a bank account in the recipient's local currency with conversion, or in a non-local currency, carries a fee of 1.2% to 4%, with minimum fees of up to $20.00 applying in selected countries.

faqs.question: Which Payoneer alternative has no monthly fee?
faqs.answer: Wise Business operates on a pay-as-you-go model with a one-time $31 setup fee. Airwallex Explore, Mercury and Relay Starter also charge $0 per month, with Mercury having no minimum balance requirements.
